There’s been growing debate around ICC finals and major knockout matches frequently being hosted in Ahmedabad. Some believe finals should rotate among legacy venues like Eden Gardens, Wankhede, and Chepauk to preserve cricketing heritage. Others counter that logistics, capacity, revenue potential, and facilities naturally make Ahmedabad a strong choice.
